subtitle: Fresh inspiration, saved your way
promotional_text: Wisdomly MOP: shuffle 300 handpicked quotes, save your favorites, and revisit moments that matter. Inspiration stays close for you and everyone you read with.
description: Wisdomly MOP is a personal sanctuary for daily inspiration. It serves 300 curated quotes across motivation, love, joy, and reflection, shuffles so recently seen lines stay back, and lets you heart favorites with timestamps. Search by text or author, switch between all quotes and favorites, and keep separate reader profiles on device. Reading streaks, themed collections, and personalized insights stay available offline with no sign-in.
app_review_notes: Wisdomly MOP is an offline quote app. Add a reader name, shuffle the highlighted quote, heart a quote to save it, then turn on Favorite mode. Explore Quotes searches the library of 300 preloaded quotes. Multiple reader profiles stay on device. No sign-in is required.
